scope: Kubernetes v1.36.1 Pod CREATE/UPDATE admission in four synthetic namespaces. Uses harmless server dry-runs and safe live marker Pods. The exempt declaration omits the Restricted allowPrivilegeEscalation=false and capabilities.drop=[ALL] settings. Confirms native namespace and RuntimeClass exemptions, then checks a synthetic ValidatingAdmissionPolicy allows only the exact named Pod, ServiceAccount, label, approved image and bounded host settings; the named RuntimeClass is restricted to its approved namespace by the compensating policy. Benign dry-run mutations test image, host settings, and UPDATE label changes. Two authenticated requester identities test username scoping with the same harmless dry-run. Real infrastructure workloads, runtime execution and controller-created Pods require additional evidence. The real audit backend records the selected workload write and Metadata for empty Secret creation. Live NetworkPolicy marker traffic is confined to tokenless benign Pods. Production RBAC/namespace governance, real workloads, and runtime behavior require additional evidence.
